messages:
Rohan G: quick note  MerchantX LoRA on int4: running small eval and seeing digit duplication + occasional truncation for invoice/amount prompts. minimal repro below.
Priya N: can you paste the exact prompt that fails?
Rohan G: `Amount due: USD 6,542.30 ->` sometimes outputs `Amount due: USD 6,542.30 30` or stops early after the cents. inconsistent, more frequent with batch>2 and ctx>=2048.
Lena V: that duplication pattern is interesting. tokenizer issue or logits oscillation from quant noise?
Omar H: first checks: tokenizer mapping, LoRA merge method, and any post-fold clamping. also try greedy decode to see determinism.
Rohan G: ran fp16 baseline  clean. ran int4 quickpack (20 invoice prompts) -> duplication in ~9% cases, truncation in ~6%. throughput +20%.
Priya N: run this focused command and attach logs: `./evals/run_quickpack.sh --model merchantx/lora --quant int4 --suite numeric --batch 1,4 --ctx 4096 --dump-logits --dump-attn --disable-fused-gemm` and for diagnostics `RUNNER_DEBUG=quant,kernels`
Lena V: also try `--merge-method=fold` vs `--merge-method=overlay` to see if folding introduces quant misalignment. dump folded weight min/max and delta stats.
Omar H: add `--dump-seq-ids` to see if EOS token appears in prompt by mistake and `--dump-token-probs` for duplicated tokens.
deploy-bot: ci/merchantx-int4-321 triggered by @Rohan G  job/321 started (docker: inference-eval:canary)
Rohan G: logs snippet: ```
[prompt] Amount due: USD 6,542.30 ->
[tokenizer] ids: [401, 23, 5021, 45, 78, 999, ...]
[emit] "Amount due: USD 6,542.30 30"
[logits] token_prob(30)=0.006, then token_prob(30)=0.005 (repeated emit)
[attn] last_layer_max: 3.2e-05
```
Priya N: repeated emit with similar small probs suggests sampling loop hitting low-entropy plateau. try greedy and top-p to compare. also run `--quant-backend=x64-fallback` to bypass optimized kernels.
Lena V: if folding pushes some logits into low dynamic range, sampling can oscillate and duplicate small tokens. patch idea: after folding LoRA into quantized weights, apply a per-tensor rescale + tiny additive floor to preserve token separation for low-prob tokens. add unit test on duplication cases.
Omar H: runtime mitigation: canary int4 at 2% for MerchantX with monitor `numeric-dup-rate`. if >3% duplicate rate, auto-route to fp16 or `quant:safe` preset. include alerting in Console.
Rohan G: uploaded artifacts (traces + folded weights) to s3://redwood-evals/merchantx/321/trace_bundle.tar.gz
deploy-bot: ci/merchantx-int4-321 completed: SUCCESS (artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/merchantx/321)
Priya N: I'll assemble a customer quickpack (40 invoice prompts + notebook with repro steps, commands for hosted/private and how to run canary). will include suggested fallback commands and a short explanation of the mitigation approach.
Lena V: I'll draft the quant-rescale patch and a unit test that folds LoRA + quant and asserts duplication rate <1% on the invoice mini-suite.
Omar H: updating rollout runbook: add `numeric-dup-rate` metric, canary thresholds, and rollback playbook. also add Optimize guidance marking currency-heavy workloads as "duplication-sensitive" under aggressive quant.
Rohan G: thanks everyone  will follow up with PR links and the quickpack bundle for MerchantX.
